input: Open a high-yield savings account today

gold.taskTitle: Open a high-yield savings account today
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to open a high-yield savings account as soon as possible and needs a clear, actionable plan to do so.

questions.title: Do you already have a specific bank in mind?
questions.description: Identify whether the user has already researched or chosen a bank or financial institution for the account.

questions.title: What is your initial deposit amount?
questions.description: Determine how much money the user plans to deposit when opening the account.

questions.title: Do you want an online bank or a traditional one?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user prefers a fully digital bank or a brick-and-mortar institution with online capabilities.

questions.title: Is this account for a specific savings goal?
questions.description: Understand the purpose of the account, such as emergency fund, home purchase, vacation, or general savings.

questions.title: Do you have your ID and SSN documents ready?
questions.description: Check whether the user has the required identification documents needed to complete the account application.

questions.title: Are you opening this as an individual or joint account?
questions.description: Determine whether the account will be solely in the user's name or shared with another person.

questions.title: What minimum APY rate are you hoping to get?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a target interest rate in mind to help narrow down suitable account options.
